scope: Two complete example/proof units: higher-dimensional polar Cantor lifting and harmonic-measure balayage. Complete pre-edit chapter second reads are recorded separately; no whole saved-chapter reread is inferred.
mathematical_scope: The planar radial regularizations lift to smooth functions with nonnegative ambient Laplacian, and their decreasing limit uses the earlier subharmonic limit theorem. The swept potential has zero Riesz measure on Int(overline D) and W, so its measure is supported on the boundary of overline D. No new theorem, external input or source-scope expansion.
